name: Transitions
description: Every transition the Studio renderer implements, including the glass and liquid families.

items.name: Cut
items.description: Hard cut — no blend at all.

items.name: Fade
items.description: Opacity ramp on an ease-out curve.

items.name: Wipe
items.description: Hard edge travelling left to right.

items.name: Zoom
items.description: Scales from 1.08 with the fade, never from 0.

items.name: Blur through
items.description: Focus pulls in from 18px of blur.

items.name: Iris
items.description: Circular reveal from the centre outwards.

items.name: Push up
items.description: Slides up a third of the frame as it fades.

items.name: Glass wipe
items.description: A refracting glass bar sweeps across and leaves the clip behind it.

items.name: Liquid dissolve
items.description: Warping blur dissolve — the frame melts in rather than fading.

items.name: Lens sweep
items.description: A circular lens travels across the frame, magnifying as it reveals.
